title: Prepaid Dental HMO Plans Evidence of Coverage, Article 7: Withdrawal and Termination of Coverage
content:
## Article 7 — Withdrawal and Termination of Coverage (Prepaid Dental HMO Plans)

**7.1 The subscriber's own decisions.** Withdrawing an application and ending coverage are the subscriber's own decisions; an application may be withdrawn any time before the effective date, and a voluntary termination ends coverage on the last day of the month in which it is made, after which the re-enrollment lockout (the plan's re-enrollment lockout months) applies to individual DHMO enrollment.

**7.2 Ending for other reasons.** Coverage is also ended by the company for nonpayment, loss of eligibility, a move out of the service area or end of the group contract. Coverage ends for nonpayment on the funding billing account's paid-through date when the account lapses; a child's coverage ends at the end of the month of the dependent child age limit birthday; a subscriber who moves out of the service area is disenrolled under the out-of-area disenrollment term; group enrollments end with the group contract.

**7.3 After the termination date.** Services after the termination date are at the dentist's usual fees, and an orthodontic case in progress continues only at the orthodontist's own fees.

### 7.4 End dates at a glance

| How coverage ends | Who decides | Status afterwards | Last day of coverage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Application withdrawn, any time before the effective date | The subscriber | Cancelled | The day before the coverage effective date (coverage never starts) |
| Voluntary termination | The subscriber | Terminated | The last day of the month in which the termination is made |
| Nonpayment, when the funding billing account lapses | The company | Terminated | The funding billing account's paid-through date |
| Child reaches the dependent child age limit | The company | Terminated | The last day of the month of that birthday |
| Subscriber moves out of the service area | The company | Terminated | As set by the out-of-area disenrollment term |
| Group contract ends | The company | Terminated | With the group contract |

The re-enrollment lockout follows a voluntary termination and applies to individual DHMO enrollment.

### 7.5 Cases (hypothetical dates)

1. *Withdrawal.* An application with a coverage effective date of 1 May is withdrawn on 22 April. Coverage never starts; the application is cancelled.
2. *Voluntary termination.* A subscriber ends coverage on 8 September; coverage ends on 30 September. A subscriber who ends coverage on 30 September also has coverage ending on 30 September.
3. *Nonpayment.* The funding billing account lapses with a paid-through date of 31 March; coverage ends on 31 March.
4. *Services afterwards.* A filling on 3 October for the subscriber in case 2 is at the dentist's usual fee, not at a scheduled copay.
5. *Orthodontics in progress.* An orthodontic case in progress when coverage ends continues only at the orthodontist's own fees.
